svg.title: Repo constellation: more from the archive
svg.desc: Night sky with constellations of smaller repos. DSA galaxy: dsa_algo with 140 files and blind_leetcode_python with 53 problem-solving files, one dot per file. FastAPI patterns: fastapi_practices, fastapi_sql_aws_base. Containers: flask_mongo_dockerized, heroku_deploy_flask. Frontend and 3D: Babylon_Vue (Vue 3 + Babylon.js PBR), react-basics-rejuvenation, AngularInMemoryCompanyAdmin. Tools: github-stats (Flask + pygal language charts).
